request.deadline: Instantly as part of the governance action's enactment on-chain
deliverables: Instant on-chain distribution of 103,000 ADA as part of enactment
Reimbursement of an alleged lost 100,000 ADA governance action deposit
Additional 3,000 ADA compensation for alleged lost staking rewards
request.recipient: not stated in document; described only as the Ikigai Info governance action submitter or intended recipient
request.what: Treasury withdrawal to reimburse the Ikigai Info governance action deposit.

claims.claim: An Info governance action titled "Cardanoの生きがい - Ikigai -" was submitted in September 2024 shortly after the Chang hard fork.
The Ikigai action was symbolic and asked the community to agree with a statement thanking contributors and expressing hope for Cardano's future.
A Cardano node bug permitted use of an unregistered stake key in the governance action and caused the submitter to be unable to recover a 100,000 ADA deposit.
The proposal says there was significant community sentiment that the deposit should be reimbursed because the submitter was an early pioneer of Cardano governance.
The proposal says entity-based budget submissions did not include the reimbursement once treasury withdrawals became available after the Plomin hard fork.
The Cardano in Oceania initiative included the reimbursement in its budget Info governance action, but that governance action was not approved.
The requested 103,000 ADA consists of the alleged lost 100,000 ADA deposit plus 3,000 ADA for staking rewards calculated at 2% per annum.
The proposal states there are no costs or expenses associated with the treasury withdrawal and no circumstances under which the withdrawal would be refunded to the treasury.
The recipient has not previously received Cardano treasury funds.
The proposal states the requested amount does not exceed the current Net Change Limit and that distribution can be audited on-chain.

summary: The document requests 103,000 ADA to reimburse an unnamed Ikigai Info governance action submitter for an alleged unrecoverable 100,000 ADA deposit plus 3,000 ADA in staking-reward compensation, but most material assertions are stated without supporting evidence in the anchor text.
